```python
class Gen:
    def __init__(self, fidx):
        self.fidx = fidx
        self.stmts = []
        self.memo = {}   # code -> varname
        self.n = 0
    def emit(self, code):
        # register an expression, hoisting it into a variable if composite
        v = self.memo.get(code)
        if v is None:
            v = 'v%d' % self.n; self.n += 1
            self.memo[code] = v
            self.stmts.append('%s=%s' % (v, code))
        return v
```
